decisions.decision: Version forecast inputs in a data version repository
decisions.context: Forecasts must be reproducible for past weeks, so each run needs a traceable input snapshot. The design space compares repository based versioning with code repository versioning and no versioning.
decisions.rationale: A versioned data snapshot makes past weekly forecasts replayable. The checked design point had no warnings; no sources attested to the combination.
consequences: Record the input snapshot for each forecast run.
Maintain storage and retention for data versions.

decisions.decision: Process retail demand in weekly batches
decisions.context: The system produces weekly forecasts per store and product. The design space offers batch and real time processing.
decisions.rationale: Weekly outputs do not require continuous processing, so batch processing fits the stated cadence and simplifies repeatable runs.
consequences: Schedule data preparation and forecasting for each weekly period.
Late arriving data needs an explicit rerun policy.

decisions.context: The brief describes weekly forecasts and a small team responsible for the pipeline end to end. The design space includes batch, incremental, and hybrid learning.
decisions.rationale: The weekly cadence supports scheduled training and a clear record of the model produced by each run. The checked design point had no warnings; no sources attested to the combination.
consequences: Retrain on a defined schedule or when the team approves a new model.
Retain training inputs and run metadata for reproducibility.

decisions.decision: Use a CI/CD pipeline for model delivery
decisions.context: New model ideas should reach production quickly without disrupting the weekly run. The design space compares CI/CD, scripts, an ML orchestrator, and no delivery automation.
decisions.rationale: A CI/CD pipeline automates repeatable delivery and supports fast iteration. The checked design point had no warnings; no sources attested to the combination.
consequences: Encode build and release steps in the pipeline.
Keep production promotion behind quality checks.

decisions.decision: Keep one model version in production and retain rollback
decisions.context: A new model must not break the weekly run. The design space covers single or multiple live versions and rollback to a prior version.
decisions.rationale: A single production model keeps the weekly run straightforward; retain prior artifacts and a rollback procedure as an operational safeguard. The rival checked point also produced no warnings, and neither combination had source attestations.
consequences: Promote a candidate only after checks pass.
Keep the previous deployable model available for recovery.

decisions.decision: Gate model promotion on trained model quality
decisions.context: The brief requires new model ideas to reach production without breaking a recurring forecast run. The design space includes tests of model quality, component behavior, and deployment strategies.
decisions.rationale: Assessing candidate model quality directly addresses whether a new model is suitable for production. The design point used canary testing as a rival; neither checked point produced warnings or source attestations.
consequences: Define forecast quality measures and promotion thresholds.
Run quality checks before production promotion.

decisions.context: A weekly production run needs a way to detect when model behavior degrades after release. The design space includes model performance monitoring, prediction logging, and production tracking.

alternatives.label: Monitoring or logging data and predictions

decisions.rationale: Performance monitoring gives the team a signal for detecting forecast degradation after a candidate is promoted.
consequences: Review performance signals as part of weekly operations.
